source.active_destination: ruby/gems/tree_haver contracts plus shared backend/profile/capability fixtures

kept_contracts.old_behavior: Expose start_line, end_line, source_position, and child traversal consistently across backend node classes.
kept_contracts.active_contract: Normalized nodes and capability reports expose source spans with 1-based lines plus explicit columns/byte ranges when available.

kept_contracts.old_behavior: Document backend support differences and parser-specific capabilities.
kept_contracts.active_contract: BackendCapability reports parser identity, language/version, parse-error behavior, source span/fragment support, render strategies, semantic roles, normalized tree support, native node access, and diagnostics.

kept_contracts.old_behavior: Allow backend selection and backend-specific suite execution.
kept_contracts.active_contract: Backend selection is explicit through registry/context/profile fields and appears in suite planning, skipped results, and reports.

kept_contracts.old_behavior: Backend selection can be scoped for one operation.
kept_contracts.active_contract: Temporary backend context is scoped and restored after the operation.

kept_contracts.old_behavior: Top-level wrappers hide backend-specific object shapes from user code.
kept_contracts.active_contract: Providers may keep native objects internally, but downstream consumers receive one normalized tree shape with metadata/sidecars for parser-specific value.

retired_or_downgraded_claims.old_claim: One Ruby TreeHaver adapter abstracts MRI, Rust, FFI, Java, Prism, Psych, Commonmarker, Markly, Citrus, and Parslet.
retired_or_downgraded_claims.replacement: active providers register capabilities and prove backend behavior through fixtures

retired_or_downgraded_claims.old_claim: TreeHaver::Parser owns all wrapping and unwrapping while backends use raw objects.
retired_or_downgraded_claims.replacement: normalized output and capability contracts; implementation internals are provider-owned

retired_or_downgraded_claims.old_claim: Backend selection may be switched at runtime for tests and parser choice.
retired_or_downgraded_claims.replacement: explicit scoped backend context, profile fields, and observable reports

retired_or_downgraded_claims.old_claim: Backend dependency tags decide which specs execute.
retired_or_downgraded_claims.replacement: feature-profile requirements and explicit skipped conformance results

decision: Port the old position and capability ideas as normalized contracts. Treat old wrapping/unwrapping and multi-backend Ruby adapter details as provider-owned implementation patterns, not shared portable API.

verification.command: mise exec -C structuredmerge/ruby -- bundle exec rspec gems/tree_haver/spec/fixtures_integration_spec.rb
